task_description: Cluster AcmePulse Google review themes into deduped problem and feature tickets, write tickets.md, put the backlog into remote GBrain over MCP, and upsert rows into a Notion Factory features database

result.summary: Loaded 6 themes including duplicate export and dark-mode clusters
Implemented dedupe + bug→problem / feature→feature ticket minting CLI
Remote MCP put_page/remember client using GBRAIN_MCP_URL + GBRAIN_TOKEN
Idempotent Notion upsert by Ticket ID using NOTION_TOKEN + NOTION_DATABASE_ID

input.command: cd factory && uv run tickets --in data/themes_acmepulse.json --out data/tickets_acmepulse.json

result.summary: Wrote 4 tickets: export problem, dark mode feature, notifications problem, mobile problem

input.command: cd factory && uv run gbrain-sync --put reviews/tickets --search 'AcmePulse tickets export'

result.summary: put_page reviews/tickets on https://gbrain.io/mcp; search returned the tickets page

input.command: cd factory && uv run notion-sync --in data/tickets_acmepulse.json

result.summary: Upserted 4 AcmePulse tickets into Notion Factory features DB (Ticket ID keyed)
Verified tickets.md written under company memory
